text: {"assertions":["A malformed record bug in ingest/pipeline/parser.py on 2026-03-02 affected only records with non-ASCII names.","The root cause was the config loader reading the wrong environment file.","The bug manifested as a decode error pointing to a specific byte offset.","The bug reproduced using a mixed-encoding sample file.","The fix made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity in PR #1670 on branch fix/malformed-record-1.","After the fix was deployed, nightly rollup matched source counts for 47 consecutive days.","This malformed record work occurred in the same area of ingest/pipeline/parser.py as earlier similar work, allowing context to carry over."]}
